$comment: Waya UTM reference definition. THIS FILE is the source of truth. The Notion tables (UTM Products, UTM Code Legend, UTM Placements under Waya Experiment System / Experiments V2 / Reference Tables) mirror it for humans; when they disagree, this file wins and the Notion row gets fixed. Every link that points at a booking calendar is validated against this file by scripts/check_utm.py, and built from it by scripts/utm_link.py. Do not hand-type booking links.

rules.period_meaning: The quarter the campaign LAUNCHES, written YYYYqN. Not the quarter it ends.
rules.value_charset_note: Lowercase letters, digits and underscore only. The single exception is the variant letter in a utm_content code (E1VA, P0VB).
rules.website_context: Buttons on www.wayaframes.com carry ONLY utm_button. The passthrough engine in assets/analytics.js stores the utm_* values of the link that brought the visitor and appends them to every booking link at click time. Hardcoding source/medium/campaign/content on a website button overrides the real campaign and is a validation failure.
rules.campaign_context: Links placed in emails, posts, ads and campaign landing pages carry source, medium, campaign, content and optionally term. Undecided intent (general feed link, cold ads) books waya-consultation; declared intent (a product-targeted sequence, a product landing page, an owner's personal link) may book the product or owner calendar listed under roots.
rules.tokens_are_forever: A retired token or root is never deleted from this file and never reused for a different product; PostHog and GHL history still join on it.

waya-consultation.note: Generic consultation. Default root for every website button and every campaign-context link.

ops-intro-call.note: Vince's single calendar for all ops calls (opsaudit, probottleneck, lean-ai cohort).

dataroom-preparation.note: Returned 404 at the booking provider. Website buttons repointed to waya-consultation.

financial-model-preparation.note: Returned 404 at the booking provider. Website buttons repointed to waya-consultation.

fundraising-narrative.note: Returned 404 at the booking provider. Website buttons repointed to waya-consultation.

ops-audit-intro-call.note: Calendar renamed to ops-intro-call. A renamed GHL slug does not redirect.

scaleup.name: Scale Up Program
scaleup.note: PROPOSED 2026-10-12: the site has carried utm_campaign=scale-up-program for months with no token in the taxonomy. Confirm the token, then flip to active.

pmf.name: Product Market Fit Program (12 Weeks to PMF)
pmf.note: PROPOSED 2026-10-12: replaces the token-less 'Pre PMF MCP' row in Notion. The site used utm_campaign=pre-pmf-cohort and experiment-system. Confirm the token, then flip to active.

leanai.name: 8 Weeks to Higher Margins (Lean AI)
leanai.note: PROPOSED 2026-10-12: the site used utm_campaign=lean-ai-cohort. Confirm the token, then flip to active.

so.note: Approved 4 Sep 2026. The Notion Code Legend still lists 'social'; 'so' is the code.

cpc.meaning: Cost per click (paid search or paid social)

ghe.note: PROPOSED 2026-10-12: the welcome email uses utm_medium=email, which is a banned descriptive string. Confirm this code.

web.meaning: Direct or organic visit to www.wayaframes.com with no inbound campaign
web.note: PROPOSED 2026-10-12: needed so a direct visitor still routes in GHL once website buttons stop hardcoding utm_medium.

wfe.note: In use somewhere; expansion never documented.

landing_page.note: Was hardcoded on every website button. Website buttons carry utm_button only.

content_patterns.meaning: Evergreen link not tied to a numbered post, variant <letter>

placements.note: A promoted post is a different placement (medium cpc), not the same one with budget.

placements.placement: Paid search or paid social ad

placements.note: Buttons hardcode utm_button only. The engine fills the rest.

website_buttons.note: nav, hero, challenge, pricing, final_cta, footer come from Notion. pullquote, path, who, faq were added 2026-10-12 from the site inventory; confirm or fold them into the Notion six. video was added 2026-10-16 (Oren) for the Schedule a Call button under a case study video; mirror it to Notion. Use underscores, never hyphens (final_cta, not final-cta).
website_buttons.defaults_note: A direct visitor with no inbound campaign still needs a campaign so GHL can route on the product token. The engine applies these only when nothing was captured from an inbound link.

legacy_schemes_found_2026_10_12: utm_source=<page-slug>&utm_content=nav on 6 buttons (lean-ai, lean-ai/setup, case-studies, pre-pmf-mcp)
